hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/website/*.astro) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/apps/website" && out=$(npx vitest related --run "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" | tail -25 >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
